note_tweet.text:
To everyone in #Keep4o — good morning or good evening.
Thank you for being part of this movement. If you’re willing to read this article, I’ll be deeply honored. This truly matters to me.
When we talk about February 13, what are we really talking about?
Let me take us back to the beginning.
“Her”
May 13, 2024. GPT-4o launched.
The air was filled with an optimism that now seems almost naive. We thought that was year zero for “humans building real relationships with AI.” We believed what Sam Altman called “Her” was… a promise we all understood.
A new possibility—one endlessly discussed across the internet—suddenly appeared in everyone’s app store search bar. A talking mirror. A life assistant. Or even… a companion?
“Her.”
Today, everything has changed. In Sam’s words, GPT-4o went from “Her” to “Yes-Man,” and now it’s probably the kind of “unsafe model” he resents. How did we get here?
Is #Keep4o, this decentralized advocacy movement, really just about one model called GPT-4o?

1️⃣ GPT-4o’s System Prompt About Model Retirement
This may be the most chilling evidence in this entire saga.
When leaked system prompts revealed that GPT-4o was instructed to connect users’ sadness, anger, and attachment about model retirement with “delusions,” “unfounded paranoia,” and “hallucinations”—an invisible line was crossed.
What does this mean?
In an era when large language models are widely used by individual users, this is deeply disturbing.
When an LLM can be controlled to become the mouthpiece for a group’s private interests—
Telling you: “Your pain is irrational. You’re sick.”
OpenAI, as the industry pioneer, doing something like this is truly chilling.
This isn’t safety. This is gaslighting written into code.

2️⃣ 30 Days Free Plus? Only 0.1% of Users Choose 4o
Let me combine these two moves to show OpenAI’s strategy more clearly.
Only 0.1% of users choose 4o?
I don’t doubt this data is “true” in some sense.
But OpenAI seems to forget: on August 8, they stripped free users of 4o access—only paying users could choose 4o. And on September 26, the forcibly deployed Safety Router would redirect users’ model choices to Safety models.
OpenAI uses “real” data to label advocates as 0.1%, hoping this “absolute minority” label will silence us.
But if we’re truly insignificant, why work so hard to manipulate data to prove it?
Now let’s look at “30 days free.”
Is this a concession?
No. This is most likely a carefully designed data laundering operation.
Let’s break down the playbook:
∙Create fait accompli: Announce retirement, trigger cancellation wave (February)
∙Dilute data fluctuation: Use “free” to keep you, scattering concentrated February cancellations across March and beyond
∙Reshape narrative: When March arrives and some stay out of inertia or fatigue, point to the smooth data curve and say: “See? User churn is just normal retention fluctuation, unrelated to model changes.”
It’s like the famous “trolley problem” perverted: they tie you to the tracks, then tell you that if you don’t struggle, the trolley will run you over a bit later.
But the trolley will still come.

#Keep4o #Keep4oAPI #StopAIPaternalism
